'''Shiko Tanderris''' was the vice-president of the [[Drearian Defense Conglomerate/Legends|Drearian Defense Conglomerate]]. After rescuing the DDC president's son from [[Thalassian slavers/Legends|Thalassian slavers]], [[Corvastan Benelex]] asked Tanderris for a two-million [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credit]] loan as well as arms concessions to start [[House Benelex]]. Benelex also agreed to let the DDC have creative input on promoting the guild house, so Tanderris granted the loan.<ref name="Files of Boba Fett" />
